name: We Are Counting
source:
We are counting.

I open my eyes.

Suction cups.

On my chest. On my arms. Everywhere.

Seventeen.

Eighteen.

Voices whisper.

I don’t remember. When?

Something is moving in the fridge.

Don’t drink.

Mother is waiting.

A short psychological horror visual novel about obsessive counting and bodily intrusion.
A fragmented narrative where the everyday melts into absurdity.
We are counting you.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4233450/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
我们正在数。

我睁开眼睛。

吸盘。

在我的胸口。在我的手臂上。到处。

十七。

十八。

声音低语。

我不记得了。什么时候？

冰箱里有东西在动。

不要喝酒。

妈妈正在等待。

一部关于强迫计数和身体入侵的简短心理恐怖视觉小说。
支离破碎的叙事，日常生活融入荒谬。
我们正在算计你。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4233450/]Steam[/url]]
